"""Separate closure review; never changes original failed diagnostic status."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl, importlib.util, json, re
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-phase-prefill-12k-20261013')
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('direct_owner', B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(sp.origin)=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 original=B/'main-phase-head-alias-12k-admission-root-v1/record.json'
 old=json.loads(original.read_text()); original_sha=m.sha(original)
 assert not old['active'] and not old['passed'] and not old['complete']
 c=next(v for v in old['commands'] if v['label']=='engine-phase-lifetime')
 assert c['exit_code']==1 and c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored']
 assert not c['cleanup'] and not c['errors'] and not c['survivors'] and not c['observation_complete']
 assert 'FATAL phase-cache fresh GEN transition failed: insufficient fresh free' in c['error']
 ident=m.identity(c['pid']); assert ident is None or ident['start_ticks']!=c['direct_identity']['start_ticks']
 out=B/'main-phase-12k-negative-admission-closure-root-v1'; assert not out.exists(); out.mkdir()
 stderr=(original.parent/'commands/engine-phase-lifetime.stderr').read_text()
 stdout=(original.parent/'commands/engine-phase-lifetime.stdout').read_text()
 assert m.sha(original.parent/'commands/engine-phase-lifetime.stderr')==c['logs']['engine-phase-lifetime.stderr']['sha256']
 assert m.sha(original.parent/'commands/engine-phase-lifetime.stdout')==c['logs']['engine-phase-lifetime.stdout']['sha256']
 ledgers=[dict((k,int(v)) for k,v in re.findall(r'(\w+)=(\d+)',row)) for row in re.findall(r'strata phase-capacity: capacity=12288 ([^\n]+)',stderr)]
 assert len(ledgers)==2 and ledgers[0]['requested_peak_bound']<=ledgers[0]['fresh_free'] and ledgers[1]['requested_peak_bound']>ledgers[1]['fresh_free']
 assert all(v['physical_fit_proof']==0 for v in ledgers)
 assert old['requests'][0]['complete'] and 'complete' not in old['requests'][1]
 assert stdout.count('DONE ')==1 and 'FATAL phase-cache fresh GEN transition failed: insufficient fresh free' in stdout
 assert re.findall(r'strata phase-capacity: configured=12288 actual_run_T=(\d+) pos=(\d+)',stderr)==[('1023','0')]
 assert stderr.count('strata phase-cache: fresh_GEN workspace_reinitialized capacity=12288')==1
 assert stderr.count('strata head-lease: reloaded ')==1
 assert stderr.count('strata head-lease: released ')==2
 env=dict(old['environment'])
 util=dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',XDG_RUNTIME_DIR='/run/user/1000',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],evidence={},original_failed_receipt=dict(path=str(original),sha256=original_sha,passed=False,complete=False,observation_complete=False),source_revision=old['source_revision'],source_pins=old['source_pins'],binary_sha256=old['binary_sha256'],boot_id=old['boot_id'],provider_hashes=old['provider_hashes'],capacity_ledgers=ledgers,first_short_request_complete=True,second_long_request_not_admitted=True,actual_chunk_rows=[['1023','0']],free_drop_bytes=ledgers[0]['fresh_free']-ledgers[1]['fresh_free'],free_drop_cause='unattributed',performance_eligible=False,quality_qualified=False,full_physical262144_qualified=False,capacity_admitted=False,reset_executed=False,service_changes=False,controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__),retention=dict(owner='main',budget_bytes=8<<20,consumer='closed negative12K admission review and next gated alias candidate',next_review='after candidate model qualification and committed report'))
 def save(): (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save); r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,selected_env=util,wall=120):
  print('CLOSURE '+label,flush=True)
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,selected_env,W,wall=wall,cpu=1800,rss_cap=2<<30,text_cap=4<<20,total_cap=8<<20)
  r['evidence'][label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
  return so.read_text()
 fault=re.compile(r'page fault|fault response|timestamp stuck|wedg|engine reset|gt reset|guc.*(?:timeout|timed out|failed)|device.*lost|Timed out wait for G2H|Check job timeout|Timedout job|Schedule disable failed|trying reset|\breset (?:queued|started|done)\b',re.I)
 def kernel(label):
  rows=[json.loads(v) for v in run(label,['/usr/bin/journalctl','-k','--after-cursor',old['kernel_cursor'],'--no-pager','-o','json']).splitlines() if v.strip()]
  failures=[v for v in rows if fault.search(str(v.get('MESSAGE','')))]
  dump=Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:05:00.0/devcoredump/data').exists()
  r.setdefault('kernel_checks',{})[label]=dict(total_rows=len(rows),fault_entries=failures,dump_present=dump); save(); assert not failures and not dump
 try:
  assert Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()==old['boot_id']
  assert run('source-head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip()==old['source_revision']
  assert not run('source-status',['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all']).strip()
  assert all(m.sha(W/k)==v for k,v in old['source_pins'].items())
  assert m.sha(old['engine_argv'][0])==old['binary_sha256']
  assert all(m.sha(k)==v for k,v in old['provider_hashes'].items())
  kernel('kernel-before-posthealth')
  health=B/'xe-source-llvm-small-health-root-v3/health'
  assert m.sha(health)=='3ce3e127898ff1e800b51a24a0369fc5b4a64e864320eed83c9cf21719b1bbe3'
  answer=run('health-after-negative-admission',[str(health),'0000:05:00.0'],env)
  assert 'PASS 0000:05:00.0: 1 round, 16384 exact words' in answer.splitlines()
  assert {v.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for v in answer.splitlines() if v.startswith('LIBRARY ')}==set(old['provider_hashes'])
  r['gpu_healthy_after_negative_admission']=True;save()
  kernel('kernel-after-posthealth')
  expected=old['model-hashes-before']['files']
  answer=run('model-hashes-after-negative-admission',['/usr/bin/sha256sum',*expected],wall=600)
  actual=dict((v[66:],v[:64]) for v in answer.splitlines()); assert actual==expected
  r['full_model_hashes_after']=actual
  assert all(m.sha(k)==v for k,v in old['provider_hashes'].items())
  assert all(m.sha(W/k)==v for k,v in old['source_pins'].items())
  assert Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()==old['boot_id'] and m.sha(original)==original_sha
  r.update(passed=True,complete=True,original_status_preserved=True,negative_capacity_outcome_reviewed=True)
 except BaseException as error: r['error']=repr(error)
 finally: r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','complete','error','gpu_healthy_after_negative_admission','free_drop_bytes')}),flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] and r['complete'] else 1)
